.styleSeqlevels

Source: R/regionLists.R
dot-styleSeqlevels.Rd

Renames the chromosomes of a GRanges to a naming style, editing the prefix by hand when the conversion of GenomeInfoDb does not cover the contigs at hand.

Usage

.styleSeqlevels(x, seqlevelsStyle = "UCSC")

Arguments

x

GRanges object.

seqlevelsStyle

String with the style, one among "UCSC", "Ensembl" and "NCBI".

Value

The object with its chromosomes renamed.

Author

Sebastian Gregoricchio
